cctv-wall.subject_label: A security camera on a wall
cctv-wall.reveal_note: In the AI image the text engraved on the camera is gibberish, the bracket is one smooth sculpted piece with almost no fixings, no cable enters the camera, and it floats against a seamless grey backdrop. The real photo shows two cameras bolted to rough concrete, with conduit and junction boxes.

id-badge.reveal_note: In the AI image the badge text is smudged lines that cannot be read, the photo on it is a tiny blur, and the glass offices behind are a soft wash. The real photo's badge shows a clear name, job title and barcode.

patch-panel.reveal_note: In the AI image every cable is the same blue with no labels, the plugs go into a black strip with no distinct ports while the switch above has nothing connected, and the bundle melts into a smooth mass. The real photo has colour-coded cables and labelled ports.

sticky-note.subject_label: A sticky note beside a keyboard
sticky-note.reveal_note: In the AI image the handwriting on the note is a loop of scribble that never forms a word, and the keyboard keys fade to blank grey where the shadow falls. The real photo has a plain note pad and a keyboard with clear key labels (page up, clear, F-keys).

whiteboard-diagram.reveal_note: In the AI image the writing on the sticky notes and on the sketch is look-alike scribble with no readable word, and the notes' folded backs show red wedges that don't match their orange fronts. The real photo has a readable flow chart: Dashboard, Plans, Budget, Media.

panel-techs.subject_label: Two technicians at a wiring cabinet
panel-techs.reveal_note: In the AI image the two men look like near-twins in different shirts and both stare straight at the camera, the red logo on one pocket is scribble, and the breaker rows are repeated blocks of tangled red wire that go nowhere. The real photo has labelled breaker modules and real hands.

server-aisle.subject_label: A technician in a server aisle
server-aisle.reveal_note: In the AI image the racks are repeating smeared blocks with no labels or cables, the far end of the aisle melts into a grey smudge, and the arm of his glasses vanishes into his hair. The real photo shows a technician pushing a real cable into a rack.

team-table.reveal_note: In the AI image the charts on the papers are blue shapes with no axes or words, the two potted plants are copies of each other, and everyone has the same soft, glossy skin. The real photo is five colleagues of different ages leaning over one laptop.

hacker-hall.subject_label: A person working at a desk, seen from behind
hacker-hall.reveal_note: In the AI image code falls like rain down the wall and is printed on the back of the hoodie, and the walls of server racks melt into each other with no cables or gaps. The real photo is a man at a plain desk in a bright room, with a typewriter and a globe.
